claims.claim: 截至2026-10-06，19 U.S.C. 1321(a)(2)(C)的800美元de minimis行政免税已对邮政和非邮政商业进口暂停；低值商品需要适当的formal或informal entry。
claims.counterevidence: Bona fide gifts和旅客随身个人/家庭物品的独立豁免未被这些规则取消。

claims.claim: 平台若代表消费者从事报关、归类、估价、准备拟提交CBP的报关文件等customs business，通常需要customs broker license；仅机械传输他人提供的数据明确被排除。
claims.counterevidence: 进口人可为自己账户办理customs business；部分非商业进口及特定运输活动还有法定例外。

claims.claim: CPSC对受认证要求约束的进口消费品的eFiling自2026-07-08生效；进口商品的certifier通常是Part 1110定义的importer。
claims.counterevidence: 当licensed broker作为IOR时，可在CPSC数据中识别owner/purchaser/consignee为证书责任方；个人为自用购买或接收商品通常不被CPSC视为认证责任importer。

claims.claim: 无货权且仅在通常业务中接收、持有或运输商品的3PL/freight forwarder，不会仅因该运输行为就在CPSA下被视为manufacturer、distributor或retailer。
claims.counterevidence: 该保护取决于其仅从事相应物流行为且不取得title；增加销售、进口或其他职能会改变分析。

claims.claim: FCC的产品责任不能简单等同于海关IOR：认证设备通常由certification grantee负责；SDoC进口设备则进口商可成为responsible party，且特定个人自用RF设备存在最多三台的进口条件。
claims.counterevidence: 个人自用例外只适用于法规列明的设备和条件，不能推广到商业转售或所有无线产品。

claims.claim: FCC于2026-09-11发布的新规则把在线marketplace listing与仓储、订单处理、包装、billing或fulfillment等组合明确纳入marketing，并设置FCC ID展示要求；该规则在研究截至日尚未生效。
claims.counterevidence: 规则2026-10-13才生效，FCC ID展示的实际compliance dates为2027-03-01和2027-06-01，并有旧listing、低量卖家和二手设备等例外。

claims.claim: 纯comparison/link-out模式较不容易成为INFORM Consumers Act意义下的online marketplace；一旦平台允许第三方卖家通过其完成sale、purchase、payment、storage、shipping或delivery并与消费者存在相应平台合同，INFORM义务明显增加。
claims.counterevidence: 具体产品流程可能即使没有完整checkout也满足法定定义的一部分，需要根据最终合同和功能逐项判断。

claims.claim: Superbuy公开资料确认其可按用户指示采购、仓储、合并包裹，并由指定第三方进行国际运输；公开资料不足以确认每条美国线路的美国IOR或商业批量折扣结构。
claims.counterevidence: B2B页面的搜索索引曾显示batch packing和split-to-different-users能力，但本次直接页面正文为空，因此该具体功能及商业条件为UNVERIFIED。

claims.claim: 存在一种法律上可行的轻资产结构：平台不取得title、不成为IOR、不自行从事受许可customs business，把报关交给licensed broker，把仓储/拼包/运输交给3PL，同时在商业层面聚合订单量。
claims.counterevidence: 没有公开合同证明Superbuy或其他代理会按所需规模提供足够大的volume discount，或允许所有终端包裹保持所需的分散IOR结构。

claims.claim: 平台成为IOR、取得商品货权或持有美国库存会显著提高海关和产品合规责任；F类自有库存/美国仓最接近传统进口零售结构。
claims.counterevidence: IOR并非在所有法规下自动等同于唯一产品认证责任人，例如broker-as-IOR的CPSC责任可分配给owner/purchaser/consignee，FCC认证设备责任也可继续属于grantee。

claims.claim: 即使平台避免成为IOR，若其实际承担危险品pre-transport functions或自行作为NVOCC/Ocean Freight Forwarder提供海运服务，仍会触发独立的DOT/FMC监管义务。
claims.counterevidence: 这些义务与是否为customs IOR是不同维度；把相关功能外包给合规carrier/OTI可避免平台自身承担部分角色。

claims.claim: Superbuy社区证据显示2026 CPSC eFiling实施后，中国国内卖家取得美国CPC/GCC/测试资料可能成为现实操作摩擦。
claims.counterevidence: 该证据来自社区和平台账号讨论，并存在成功清关的相反个案，不能据此估计扣关率或证明所有个人进口均需同类证书。

categories.name: comparison/routing layer
categories.importer_of_record: consumer/owner/purchaser or appointed licensed broker; platform normally outside role
categories.duty_responsibility: IOR/bonded party legally; economic cost may be passed to consumer
categories.product_compliance_boundary: lowest platform exposure if no title, checkout, fulfillment or customs business

categories.name: consumer buys through Superbuy
categories.purchaser: contract-dependent; Superbuy publicly states it purchases following user instructions
categories.importer_of_record: not established by public Superbuy materials; route-specific customs documents required
categories.product_compliance_boundary: can remain relatively light, but CPSC/FCC requirements still apply to regulated goods and the actual responsible party

categories.name: platform acts as buying agent
categories.purchaser: consumer can remain principal in a genuine agency structure; exact title allocation is contractual
categories.importer_of_record: owner/purchaser or properly appointed licensed broker
categories.product_compliance_boundary: customs-broker licensing becomes critical if platform performs customs business for others

categories.name: platform aggregates shipments
categories.purchaser: aggregation alone need not change purchaser
categories.importer_of_record: must still be an eligible owner/purchaser or broker; a nominal freight forwarder cannot simply self-file as owner
categories.product_compliance_boundary: pure no-title 3PL has CPSA carve-out; hazmat and transportation licensing may arise from functions performed

categories.name: platform becomes importer of record
categories.purchaser: may or may not also be economic purchaser
categories.product_compliance_boundary: CPSC/FCC and admissibility obligations materially increase

categories.name: platform owns inventory / US warehouse
categories.purchaser: platform normally takes title before downstream consumer sale
categories.importer_of_record: typically platform or broker acting for it
categories.product_compliance_boundary: importer plus retailer/seller responsibilities; highest exposure among studied architectures
